method: Remote Desktop Commander read-only source inspection and JSON summarization; no model run, mutation, fit or cost benchmark
github_visibility: GitHub fetch returned No commit found for this ref at observation; source is local-only evidence

source_findings.finding: arm_ranking scores every supplied code and sorts the resulting scores
caller supplies the full previous-event code slice
decode_spec charges per-event work times retained s, plus LUT construction

report_definition: arm per-event decode work times s plus the arm query-LUT build; every geometric family declares zero multiplies; oracle-qk is the dense multiplier ceiling and recent-s is an address-only control
interpretation: Current implementation is a compressed all-candidate scan. Selected-set decoding estimate is not actual end-to-end search cost. Compression/recall diagnostics may remain useful.
limits: Not an independent rerun of the model or report.
Report file identities were observed; the complete sealed root was not reverified.
No final adoption or numerical-kernel compliance inference.
All-event and selected-read denominators must not be mixed.
